shots.title: First rain
shots.review: The foreground drop travels down the glass, with folded whitecaps behind it. The cool exterior holds into the cottage cut.

shots.title: The ritual
shots.review: The boy enters cleanly and echoes Granddad’s raised hand beside the open pot. Use their shared gesture to lead into the teapot insert.

shots.title: The first voice
shots.review: The first drip lands with the kettle already open. The second burst gives the enamel rhythm a clear return.

shots.title: The second voice
shots.review: Framed on the hands and the iron pot. The quieter second voice follows the enamel kettle; the contact and expanding rings stay in sync.

shots.title: The empty place
shots.review: Granddad sets the cup down and both listen. The four-second cut preserves the glance and leaves space for the missing note.

shots.title: One beat early
shots.review: The boy follows the missing beat with his eyes while Granddad keeps time. Faces, paper folds and cup placement hold through the cut.

shots.title: Again
shots.review: The held finger and listening glance stay beside the staircase. Stabilized the camera against the original cottage so the silent beat holds.

shots.title: The dry rim
shots.review: H3 added liquid to the cup. The final composite keeps the approved dry foreground and the boy’s animated glance up toward the ceiling.

shots.title: Summer's repair
shots.review: The patch explains the missing drip without a line of dialogue. Cool window light passes across the four fixings while the roof remains dry.

shots.title: Water in the hood
shots.review: Second take. The daylight wall, coat edge and paper curls stay steady as the boy notices the water in his hood.

shots.title: Borrowing a drop
shots.review: Enter on the spoon in the hood pool and hold the six-second lift. The stray incoming stream is trimmed away.

shots.title: The third voice
shots.review: Locked spoon and chipped cup. One drop lands at 4.90s, with the native strike at 4.91s.

shots.title: The answer
shots.review: The spoon settles while Granddad finishes his phrase. Cast, cup, rain window and light hold through the full eight seconds.

shots.title: In on it
shots.review: Retake cut away to the window. Selected the clean, full-resolution performance after the flash in take 1. Cup answers at 6.63s, then Granddad smiles.

shots.title: Their song
shots.review: Wide shot holds both silhouettes. Time the closing three notes to the boot exchange then leave the cottage at rest.
